editorial.blurb: A cozy neighborhood brewery with solid house-made beers, friendly service, and hearty bar fare that keeps locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit Saturday or Sunday 11am–2pm for their weekend breakfast menu featuring Avocado Toast and the 'Rise and Grindwich' bacon sandwich.

topDishes.note: Surprising standout that delights even solo diners
Fresh, chewy thick crust (though some find it wet)
Crispy jumbo wings—sauce best served on the side
